sentences.text:
Counsel for Respondent :- C.S.C.
Hon'ble Manoj Kumar Gupta,J.
Hon'ble Anish Kumar Gupta,J.
1.

The instant petition has been filed praying for a writ of mandamus commanding the respondents their agents and servant not to demolish the petitioners houses/shops situated over Gata No. 489m,
village Yasinpur @ Karnaipur, Tehsil Phulpur, District Prayagraj and not to encroach the land of the petitioners without paying compensation according to the provisions of the Right to Fair Compensation and Transparency in Land Acquisition, Rehabilitation and Resettlement Act, 2013 or according to Government Order dated 19 March 2015 and notification dated 22 October 2014.
Dilip Kumar Keshrwani And 7 Others vs State Of U.P. And 3 Others on 7 January, 2025 Indian Kanoon - http://indiankanoon.org/doc/117563286/
1 2.

entities.label: STATUTE

entities.label: PRECEDENT

sentences.text: The case of the petitioners is that the respondents intended to demolish the constructions of the petitioners and take possession of their land for widening of a public road without any formal acquisition and payment of compensation.

3. Since the State-respondents despite repeated orders declined to pay compensation to the petitioners on the pretext that the petitioners were not in settled possession of the subject land although abadi was recorded over subject land in 1359F and during consolidation operations, we required the District Magistrate to file his personal affidavit.

4. In compliance of the said direction, the District Magistrate has filed his affidavit dated 6 January 2025 and in para-8, the stand taken is as follows:
"8.

That moreover the road widening in question work has already been completed around the houses of the petitioners without affecting their constructions, on the available land and as such now the land in question is no more required.
Hence no compensation shall be payable, under the provisions of Act No.30 of 2013.

The copy of letter of Executive Engineer concerned dated 04.01.2025 is being annexed herewith and marked as Annexure-PA-2 to this affidavit."
5.
Counsel for the petitioners does not dispute that the respondents have left out the constructions and the land of the petitioners while carrying out widening of the road.
6. In such view of the matter, we are of the opinion the cause of action for instituting the present case no more survives.
7. The petition stands disposed of without any further direction.

Order Date :- 7.1.2025 Mukesh Kr.
(Anish Kumar Gupta,J.) (Manoj Kumar Gupta,J.)
